title: Valid passport
details: Personal documents: Passport issued within the last 10 years, with at least 2 empty pages.

title: Visa application form and Section 54 declaration
details: Personal documents: Completed and signed visa application form and declaration under Section 54 of the Residence Act. Submit 2 copies.

title: Additional contact and legal representation declaration
details: Personal documents: Declaration for additional contact and legal representation information. Submit 2 copies.

title: Biometric passport photos
details: Personal documents: 3 identical, recent biometric passport photos.

title: Passport data page copies
details: Personal documents: 2 copies of the passport data page, in A4 size.

title: Admission proof
details:
Letter of admission from a German university OR admission to a preparatory college (Studienkolleg) OR registration for a language course.
The letter must include the language of instruction and confirmation if a non-German degree will be awarded.

title: Blocked account (Sperrkonto)
details:
Proof of financial means. The checklist states a required amount of €11,904, with an approximate €992/month withdrawal limit.
The checklist recommends opening the blocked account only after instruction/request from the embassy.

title: Sponsor income proof (if applicable)
details:
The checklist states that the sponsor must demonstrate stable annual income of at least NPR 25 to 30 lakhs.
Acceptable income sources listed: salary (employment income), business income, house rent, and land lease income.
Supporting documents: proof of income such as salary slips, business registration, rental agreements, etc.; and the last 6 months of bank statements.

title: Bank balance / savings proof
details:
Must show sufficient funds equivalent to living costs in Germany.
The checklist gives this fund calculation: tuition + living cost (€12,000) + travel cost.
Include the last 6 months of bank statements.

title: Alternative financial proof (if applicable)
details: The checklist lists a formal obligation letter (Verpflichtungserklärung) from a sponsor in Germany, and proof of a German/EU scholarship or stipend, as alternative financial proof if applicable.

title: Academic qualifications — Bachelor’s applicants
details:
10th and 12th mark sheets.
Diploma/degree certificates, if applicable.

title: Academic qualifications — Master’s applicants
details: Bachelor’s degree certificate and other relevant academic documents.

title: Academic qualifications — PhD/Postdoc applicants
details: Master’s degree and additional qualifications.

title: Language proficiency proof
details:
Required unless confirmed in the admission letter. The checklist states that the proof must not be older than 1 year.
English: TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge.
German: Goethe-Institut, ÖSD, TestDaF, DSH.

title: Proof of tuition fee payment (if applicable)
details: Additional documents: Proof of tuition fee payment, if applicable.

title: Curriculum Vitae (CV)
details: Additional documents: Curriculum Vitae (CV).

title: Signed motivation letter / Statement of Purpose
details: Additional documents: Signed motivation letter / Statement of Purpose.

title: Travel health insurance
details: Additional documents: Travel health insurance covering the first 90 days from the entry date.

title: Visa fee payment receipt
details: Additional documents: Visa fee payment receipt.

title: Document submission notes
details:
Submit two identical sets of documents, using A4-size copies only.
Bring all original documents to the visa appointment.
The checklist states a processing time of 6–8 weeks.
The embassy may request additional documents or verification.
Submission of documents does not guarantee visa approval.
Providing false information or incomplete documents may result in rejection.
